jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Developer (Python)
jobs_results.description:
What we're looking for
• Origen.AI, an artificial intelligence startup focusing on the energy sector, is looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join our team in Spain.
• Origen.AI develops methods for modelling, simulation and optimization of complex systems, particularly systems involving physical properties. Our revolutionary technology accelerates simulations by up to 10,000x, opening up unprecedented opportunities across many different industries.
• We are based in New York (with offices in Madrid and Sevilla). This specific role will be based out of Seville, but open to fully-remote candidates legally authorized to work in Spain.
• To engage effectively with the North American team, the working hours of this position are shifted later, finishing at 7PM.
• We are creating a passionate and engaging culture that combines cutting-edge research and product-led engineering to provide a supportive balance of structure and flexibility. We are looking for colleagues passionate about... bringing cutting-edge AI to industrial problems.
• We are willing to hire both at the intermediate level and at a more senior level, depending on the level of experience of the best candidates.

Your daily routine at Origen.ai
• You will work in the Platform team, developing the Backend for PROTEUS, our SaaS client-facing platform.
• A Project Manger will organize, with your aid and technical expertise, your tasks into sprints. You will always get direct assistance either from the Technical Lead or other team members.
• You will build scalable services and components for a web-based complex architecture, deployed using CI in a cloud Kubernetes infrastructure. Your will mainly use the Python programming language to write your code and your tests.
• You will support our Research team in making their cutting-edge algorithms industry-ready. To do so, you will have to tackle challenging problems to engineer scalable, performant, and easy to maintain AI solutions.

We Offer:
• An intellectually challenging set of problems.
• Colleagues with deep knowledge and a passion for cutting edge technology.
• Excellent opportunities to grow with the company as we scale up.
• Competitive salary.
• An indefinite employment contract from the first moment.
• Employee benefits including, but not limited to, free private medical insurance and flexible benefits for food, transport, and child care.

What we Expect from You:
• To live in Spain and are eligible to work in Spain.
• 5 years of relevant experience.
• B2B SAAS development experience
• You have 3+ years of back-end development experience in one or more well-known high level Python web development framework (Flask, FastAPI, Django, AIOHTTP, etc.)
• You have 3+ years of RESTful API development experience. You can analyze a web client-server communication requirement and design a set of APIs/endpoints for it.
• You can analyze a real world problem and turn its data requirements into a relational DB model. You can implement that model using DDL in any of the major RDBMS systems (Postgres, Mysql, Oracle, etc.)
• You wouldn’t expect your code to be merged into a main branch unless tests have been written for them. You have written a plethora of tests in the past.
• Celery or Prefect and async processing expertise: You have gained experience with Celery or Prefect and asynchronous processing to efficiently handle tasks in the background and optimize backend performance.
• Experience with cloud platforms is required - Azure experience is a big plus
• You have worked with docker, and understand that docker images, among other things, ease local development and play a key role in a modern CI/CD process.
• Ability to communicate your ideas clearly and work in teams.
• Experience dealing with and managing internal and external stakeholders.
• Excellent communication skills in English.
• Suggest and engage in team collaborations to meet ambitious development goals.

How to Apply:

Does this role sound like a good fit? Please apply at the following link: https://origenai.kenjo.io/sr-backend-developer-python

jobs_results.title: Senior Back End Engineer (Python)
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

Aplazame is the business of WiZink Bank that offers flexible payment methods that enable merchants to maximize their sales and conversion rates through instant financing options. Customers also benefit from the power of spreading the cost of their purchases. Aplazame features multiple products available for online and in-store purchases. We aim to build simple financing products, transparent and fair that enable our customers to purchase the things that make them happy through responsible lending, no hidden fees and an exceptional customer experience. In order to continue growing, we’d love to find a Senior Back End Engineer (Python) for our Development Team.

Who are we looking for
• You have deep experience building Python/Django applications, and Celery/Airflow for the execution of asynchronous tasks.
• You can demonstrate significant experience implementing public and private APIs, following REST architecture (Django Rest Framework) and best practices. You will... contribute to the development our our API that enables the integration of Aplazame into ecommerce applications https://aplazame.com/integraciones/api/
• You have expertise working with legacy systems, integrating with them and are willing to challenge the current state working in refactoring and evolving those systems without impacting the business.
• You believe that unit tests development is a must practice to ensure the quality of the new functionalities that you produce.
• You are proactive pursuing performance and scalability issues in the platform.

Even if you think you can’t meet all the requirements for the position, please apply, we want to meet you. At Aplazame we think that professional growth comes from knowledge but also learning and development. We will value all candidates with a strong background in software engineering roles.

You will be our ideal candidate if
• You can demonstrate hands-on experience with CI/CD systems.
• Your technology interests include microservices and event-oriented architectures.
• You have experience working with Docker-based environments.
• You have a proactive approach to development, trying always to improve the current base code.
• You have experience moving from a Django monolithic architecture to a more modular one.

About the role
• You will become a member of the product development squads at our engineering team. Your mission will be the development of features that support our backend services.
• The backend engineering team at Aplazame is responsible for the development of the business logic of the applications, integration of multiple third-party services, API development and is an essential part for the development of new product-based features in cross-role teams with frontend, data science and integrations teams.
• You will work with a tech stack built with Python/Django, Postgres, Redis, Kafka, Cassandra, FastAPI, etc. Deployed to high-availability in Docker containers over AWS infrastructure.
• You will provide support to all areas of the company on the development of new features for the company’s backoffice panel.
• You will work close to the Data, Finance and Risk teams, helping with BI metrics, Decision Engine, Accountability, Regulatory compliance, etc.
• You will perform monitoring, bug tracking and performance analysis of the services deployed to the platform.

What do we offer?
• Permanent contract.
• Possibility of flexible hours and remote/presential work.
• Competitive conditions.
• Financial and non-financial benefits.
• An environment full of confidence and open communication. We are very horizontal. Everyone is welcome to contribute with ideas or experiences in any area.
• Culture of feedback and learning. We try not to make mistakes, but they are an excellent learning source.

Job application and recruitment process:
• If this position interests you, please upload a recent copy of your CV.
• We believe that equal opportunity means inclusion, diversity and fair treatment for all.
• We welcome suggestions on any issues that may help us to improve our recruitment process

jobs_results.title: DESARROLLADOR SR. PYTHON, AZURE
jobs_results.description:
Dimática Software (Microsoft GOLD PARTNER) es una empresa dentro del Grupo Sermicro, especializada en soluciones de desarrollo y mantenimiento de software.

Realizamos proyectos de I+D+i, considerándolos un elemento clave para nuestra competitividad. La trayectoria de Dimática en el desarrollo de software no estaría completa sin estos proyectos, cada uno siendo un punto clave para el crecimiento de la empresa.

En estos momentos necesitamos incorporar un desarrollador senior, especializado en PYTHON y entornos Cloud (Preferiblemente Azure). Para trabajar en el desarrollo y evolución del ERP y CRM de una gran empresa del sector energético

Funciones a desarrollar:
• Desarrollo backend con Python y framework Django
• Despliegues en contenedores alojados en la nube de Azure
• Desarrollo a medida dentro de Salesforce
• Testing unitario
• Mentorización de miembros junior de los equipos

¿Qué buscamos en ti?
• Experiencia con Python
• Experiencia en entornos Cloud (preferiblemente Azure)
•... Será valorable haber trabajado con Salesforce
• Experiencia trabajando en marcos agile

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?
• Horario: 8,5h de Lunes a Jueves... 7h los Viernes y los meses completos de julio y agosto
• Salario en función de experiencia previa
• Ubicación: Híbrido (2 días en remoto y 3 días en la oficina ubicada en el Parque Empresarial Cristalia (Metro San Lorenzo)
• 23 días de vacaciones al año

jobs_results.title: Python Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Staff Python Engineer
The Engineering team builds the software powering Veriff. We're cracking the online identity crisis in a scalable way, deploying excellence to keep Veriff on the cusp of innovation. It's a fast-paced market with many challenges. We're seeking an experienced team member to join our Verification Automation team as a Senior Python Engineer. As a part of our Verification Automation team at Veriff, you will be responsible for maintaining and improving our real-time Verification Platform, focusing on critical aspects like security, scalability, and maintainability.

Your role is crucial in designing and developing new systems that support Veriff's vision to build trust online through a reliable and user-friendly Identity Verification Platform.

You’ll help us protect honest people online by:

Taking charge of the design, documentation, and validation processes for product and system development, ensuring top-notch quality and innovation

Building, testing... and maintaining our automation services using Python, contributing to the efficiency and effectiveness of our platform

Working closely with a diverse team of engineers, data scientists, and machine learning experts, both within and outside the team, to tackle complex challenges and drive forward our vision for identity verification

Owning and nurturing cross-functional partnerships, including working with dependency engineering teams and product stakeholders, to align goals and strategies

Mentoring and guiding the team, ensuring they are well-equipped with the necessary skills and aligned with our mission

You are the right future Veriffian for the job if you have

Over 5 years of experience building large-scale applications with Python

A strong understanding of modular design approaches and SOLID principles, particularly in distributed systems

Hands-on experience with building scalable and maintainable APIs and message-queuing concepts

Proficiency in various test strategies, ensuring robust and reliable software solutions.

Solid understanding of fundamental relational database concepts

Familiarity with structured logging systems

Exceptional communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate and motivate technical ideas to both engineers and non-engineers

You can get familiar with our tech stack on Stack Share.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team and offices in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world.

We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force. When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include...Flexibility to work from home Stock options that ensure your share in our success

Comprehensive relocation support Extensive medical, wellness coverage to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally

Learning and Development budget that you are free to tailor for your own needs

Six weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 3rd work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

Please be informed that in the final stage of the recruitment process we may request you to go through identity verification. For more information, please see Recruitment Privacy Policy.#LI-LP1 #TBT

En QubiQ somos líderes en el ámbito de la digitalización con sede principal en Barcelona. Durante los últimos 13 años, hemos ayudado a empresas de diferentes sectores a abrazar la era digital, optimizando procesos y creando soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras que generan valor. Con el objetivo de ampliar nuestro alcance y seguir ofreciendo soluciones de vanguardia.

¿ Por qué es único formar parte del equipo de QubiQ? Más allá de nuestro compromiso con soluciones técnicas de alta calidad, nuestra fortaleza radica en las personas. Fomentamos un ambiente de respeto, apertura y comunicación efectiva, esenciales para el trabajo en equipo y la toma de decisiones. Nuestra estructura organizativa es bastante horizontal, lo cual genera un entorno propicio para la innovación continua.

Valoramos mucho el bienestar y el equilibrio en la vida de nuestros empleados, convencidos de que un estilo de vida saludable potencia la creatividad y el rendimiento. Si estos principios resuenan contigo... entonces QubiQ es tu lugar.

Detalles del Puesto:
Desarrollador/a Python Especializado en Odoo

Tipo de contrato:

Indefinido, jornada completa.

Incorporación:
Inmediata Complejidad

Evolución Personal

Autonomía

Centrados en la calidad
• Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones técnicas de calidad para nuestros clientes.
• Escribir código mantenible y testeable.
• Consultar documentación técnica.
• Comunicarte con el equipo y cliente.
• 1-3 años de experiencia desarrollo de Python. Capacidades analíticas y de diseño de software.
• Conocimientos de herramientas de control de versiones GIT.
• Habilidades interpersonales.
se valora
• Experiencia previa demostrables en Odoo u otro ERP.
• Conocimientos Postgre

SQL, Docker, JS, UI/UX, Linux o Git Hub.
Reconocemos tu dedicación y esfuerzo con un plan de carrera personalizado que refleja tanto tu tiempo en la empresa como tu rendimiento.
Formaciones

Departamento exclusivo para formar a los empleados y así mejorar nuestra profesionalidad.
Teletrabajo
Jornada laboral mixta, días en oficina y días en casa. #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a Junior o Senior SQL, Python
jobs_results.description:
Desde DTA estamos buscando ingenieros/as informáticos o de telecomunicaciones tanto junior como senior

¿QUÉ NECESITAMOS DE TI?

En el nivel junior, buscamos candidatos con conocimientos en SQL, y preferiblemente experiencia o familiaridad con Python, ya sea a través de estudios universitarios o proyectos académicos.

Para los candidatos más senior, la experiencia en SQL y Python es un requisito indispensable.

MODALIDAD DE TRABAJO: Remoto con asistencia a oficina 1 día a la semana.

¿QUE OFRECEMOS?

La oportunidad de crecer en una empresa en expansión y aportar valor real.

Un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo con metodologías ágiles.

La satisfacción de implementar soluciones que realmente impactan el día a día de nuestros clientes.

Formación personalizada: Si necesitas aprender algo nuevo, ¡estamos aquí para apoyarte!

Flexibilidad horaria y un modelo de trabajo híbrido (un día a la semana en la oficina en Vigo)

En Digital Talent Agency te ofrecemos desarrollar proyectos en... empresas destacadas del sector tecnológico, poniendo foco en tu desarrollo profesional, qué te gusta, cómo eres y con qué tipo de proyectos te sientes motivado.

¡Queremos conocerte

jobs_results.title: Python and C++ Developer
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

SOLUTE busca un Desarrollador de Python y C++ para el desarrollo del software necesario para realizar inspecciones con un dron comercial.

Al candidato se le encomendarán tareas que impliquen el conocimiento y experiencia en las siguientes tareas:
• Acreditación de conocimiento avanzado en lenguaje de programación Python.
• Muy valorable el conocimiento de otros lenguajes de programación orientados a objetos.
• Capacidad de llevar a cabo desde cero el desarrollo de software: configurar entorno de desarrollo, estructura de aplicación, documentación, implementación y compilación.

Requisitos mínimos
• Titulación: Ingeniero Aeronáutico, Ingeniero Informático, Ingeniero de Software o disciplina técnica equivalente.
• Experiencia en Python. Capacidad de desarrollar aplicaciones, scripts y automatizaciones eficientes en Python. Conocimiento en bibliotecas y frameworks relevantes.
• Dominio de C++, incluyendo la capacidad de desarrollar aplicaciones de alto rendimiento... optimizar código y abordar proyectos que requieran este lenguaje.
• Manejo de Android (Kotlin).
• Con capacidad de realizar programación ordenada y orientada a objetos.
• Buenas aptitudes comunicativas.
• Alto nivel de inglés, tanto oral como escrito.

SOLUTE ofrece:

La oportunidad de unirse a un equipo multidisciplinar compuesto por ingenieros jóvenes junto con ingenieros senior de referencia con más de 15 años de experiencia en la industria eólica.
• Conciliación.
• Salario competitivo.
• Plan de Carrera.
• Plan de formación incluyendo clases de idiomas.

jobs_results.title: Python /Django Developer ( remoto)
jobs_results.description:
Somos Plexus Tech. Una compañía tecnológica especializada en servicios y productos IT, fundada en el talento y las capacidades de nuestra gente, más de 2.000 profesionales desarrollando tecnología con alma.

Necesitamos a un/a profesional Senior con alrededor de 5 años de experiencia.

Requisitos:
• 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo con Python/ Django
• Experiencia en testing
• Conocimientos en linux y git

Ofrecemos:
• Formación a medida. Contamos con varias plataformas de formación disponibles para que todos los empleados de Plexus puedan configurar un plan formativo a medida según sus intereses profesionales.
• Formación de idiomas. Es un programa de aprendizaje y perfeccionamiento de idiomas a disposición de tod@s los trabajadores/as de la compañía. Un método que combina tecnología, contenido personalizado, interacción con el profesor y la optimización del tiempo. Incluye también clases grupales de conversación en las que podréis coincidir con alumnos de otros países.
•... Certificaciones a disposición de todos los trabajadores los recursos necesarios para preparar y obtener sus certificaciones a través de Plexus.
• Paquete de retribución Flexible: contamos con Seguro médico, Ticket Restaurante, Ticket transporte y Ticket guardería
• El Club Benefits de Plexus Tech: un servicio a disposición de todos los trabajadores de la compañía que nos permite el acceso a ofertas exclusivas en viajes, hogar, salud, tecnología, moda y demás.
• Teletrabajo 100%
• Contratación indefinida
